title: A Telescope with a Waiting List
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事は架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の研究結果や統計を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Imagine a future research station equipped with a telescope that several scientific teams must share.
sentences.ja: 複数の科学チームが共有する望遠鏡を備えた未来の研究基地を想像しよう。

sentences.en: Each team submits a proposal explaining the observations that it hopes to conduct during the next month.
sentences.ja: 各チームは翌月に行いたい観測を説明する提案書を提出する。

sentences.en: The station initially distributes equal amounts of observation time to the participating groups.
sentences.ja: 基地は当初参加グループに等量の観測時間を配分する。

sentences.en: However, the researchers soon discover that their projects have very different scheduling requirements.
sentences.ja: しかし各研究の時間設定の要件が大きく異なるとすぐ気づく。

sentences.en: One team wants to observe a fictional event expected to occur during a narrow window of time.
sentences.ja: 一つのチームは限られた時間帯に起こると予想される架空の現象を観測したい。

sentences.en: Another team plans to collect repeated measurements over several weeks to examine a gradual change.
sentences.ja: 別のチームは緩やかな変化を調べるため数週間にわたり繰り返し測定する計画だ。

sentences.en: An identical allocation cannot necessarily satisfy both types of investigation equally well.
sentences.ja: 同一の配分では両種類の調査を等しく満たせるとは限らない。

sentences.en: The station therefore requests information about the flexibility and urgency of each proposed observation.
sentences.ja: そこで基地は各観測案の柔軟性と緊急性について情報を求める。

sentences.en: The scheduling committee separates requests that depend on particular times from those that can be moved easily.
sentences.ja: 日程委員会は特定の時刻に依存する要望と容易に移動できる要望を分ける。

sentences.en: It reserves some observation periods for unexpected opportunities or interruptions.
sentences.ja: 予期しない機会や中断に備えて観測期間の一部を確保する。

sentences.en: The committee also publishes the principles used to decide between competing requests.
sentences.ja: 競合する要望の判断に使う原則も公開する。

sentences.en: These principles include scientific relevance, scheduling constraints, and the availability of alternative methods.
sentences.ja: 原則には科学的意義、日程上の制約、代替方法の有無が含まれる。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a published procedure does not remove every disagreement about research priorities.
sentences.ja: それでも公開された手順は研究の優先順位についての全意見相違をなくさない。

sentences.en: A team whose request is postponed may still question the committee's interpretation of its importance.
sentences.ja: 要望が延期されたチームは重要性についての委員会の解釈に疑問を持つこともある。

sentences.en: The station establishes a short review process through which researchers can provide additional relevant evidence.
sentences.ja: 基地は研究者が追加の関連証拠を提出できる短い見直し手続きを設ける。

sentences.en: The final schedule is periodically reconsidered when new information becomes available.
sentences.ja: 新情報が得られたら最終日程を定期的に見直す。

sentences.en: This thought experiment illustrates the distinction between equal distribution and meaningful access to a limited resource.
sentences.ja: この思考実験は限られた資源の平等な配分と意味ある利用機会の違いを示す。

sentences.en: Fairness may require considering the conditions under which each recipient can benefit from an allocation.
sentences.ja: 公平性には各受け手が配分から恩恵を受ける条件の考慮が必要な場合がある。

sentences.en: At the same time, flexibility must be accompanied by transparent reasons and opportunities for review.
sentences.ja: 同時に柔軟性には透明な理由と見直し機会が伴わなければならない。

sentences.en: The hypothetical telescope is valuable not merely because it is powerful, but because researchers can use it responsibly together.
sentences.ja: 仮想の望遠鏡は高性能なだけでなく研究者が責任を持って共同利用できるため価値がある。

vocabulary.definition: an instrument for viewing distant objects
a share assigned for a purpose
in a way that must be true
a group chosen to decide things
assumed for the sake of reasoning

questions.prompt: Why might equal time be insufficient?
options: Some observations depend on specific timing.
Every team needs exactly the same schedule.
No team can use a telescope.
questions.explanation_ja: 特定時刻が重要な観測もある。
不測の機会や中断に備える。

options: A promise that all requests will be accepted.

questions.prompt: What can researchers do through review?

options: All published principles have no value.
Every observation is fictional in the station's plan.
New information may affect the allocation.
questions.explanation_ja: 新情報で配分を調整できる。

options: Assumed for the sake of reasoning.

questions.prompt: What principle does the example illustrate?
options: Identical time always guarantees equal benefit.
The best telescope needs no scheduling.
All competing requests should be ignored.
Fair access to shared resources can require flexibility and transparent reasons.
questions.explanation_ja: 資源配分には柔軟性と透明性が必要。

grammar.explanation_ja: not necessarilyは必ずしも〜とは限らない。
前置詞＋関係代名詞whichがprocessを説明。
must be＋過去分詞は義務の受動態。

paraphrases.source: An identical allocation cannot necessarily satisfy both types of investigation equally well.
paraphrases.rewrite: Giving both projects identical amounts of time may not meet their needs equally well.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 等量では必要を満たせない場合。

paraphrases.source: The station establishes a short review process through which researchers can provide additional relevant evidence.

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 追加の根拠を提出できる見直し手続き。

paraphrases.explanation_ja: 理由と見直しの機会が必要。
